Harmless Appearance.effect: Looks harmless; automatic Initiative win on the first encounter with a given opponent (lost once they know better).

Channeler.effect: Convert HP into Magic Points: 6 HP → 1 MP at 2 points; 3 HP → 1 MP at 4 points.

Crowd Control.effect: Gift of speech; manipulate crowds (Leadership test) — incite, sell, give speeches.

Courage.effect: Immune to conventional fear; doubles WILL resistance vs. fear effects.

Magic Powers.effect: Scaling Focus/Magic points (1 point = 2 Focus/1 Magic ... 5 points = 9 Focus/7 Magic).

Faith Points.effect: Follower(1) / Faithful(2) / Enthusiast(3) / Fanatic(5) / Radical(7) Faith points.

Heroic Points (cost scale).effect: Brave(1) / Valiant(2) / Intrepid(3) / Hero(4) — extra heroic HP per level.

Quick Draw.effect: Draw a weapon without spending an action; +4 Initiative that round.

Secret Society.effect: Outer-circle/apprentice member or inner-circle member with rank, of a mystic order.

Calm Temperament.effect: Doubles test values for self-control/concealment tests (WILL, Charisma, Fast Talk, Intimidation).

Eternal Life.effect: Lived 100-150 / 200-250 / 300-400 years; grants +100/+150/+200 skill points (top tier implies a powerful enemy).

Ambidexterity.effect: Weapons are used with the same difficulty in either hand.

Attack on the Move.effect: Allows you to move, perform an action, and move again.

Special Attack.effect: Use a Heroic Point to double the damage dealt.

Enhanced Sneak Attack.effect: If you hit an enemy from behind, add 1d6 extra damage (2); if the attack is a surprise attack, in addition to the extra damage, treat the hit as a Critical Hit (4).

Powerful Attack.effect: Use a Heroic Point to add 1d6 damage and push the enemy back.

Brute.effect: CON+1 (1), STR+1 and CON+1 (2), or STR+1 and CON+2 (3).

Camouflage.effect: Add 10% to tests for hiding and stealth.

Cause Bleeding.effect: Use a Heroic Point to add 1d6 to damage and leave the enemy with the 'bleeding' status.

Demon Hunter.effect: Add 25% hit chance and 1d6 damage against 'demon' type enemies.

Fatal Cut.effect: Use a Heroic Point to deal critical damage when hitting an enemy.

Deflect Objects.effect: Add 25% chance to deflect when targeted by projectiles or thrown objects.

Hard to Kill.effect: When taking damage that would reduce your HP to 0 or less, add your Constitution modifier as HP (this enhancement can only be used once per combat).

Combat Specialization.effect: Add 25% chance to defend against the next attack if taking a defensive stance (2); additionally, if the received attack is melee, perform a counter-attack (4).

Supernatural Dodge.effect: Add 25% chance to dodge an attack.

True Arrow.effect: Add 25% chance to hit an attack with a ranged weapon.

Weapon Focus.effect: Add 25% chance to hit an attack (2); or 25% chance to hit an attack and 25% chance to parry with your weapon (3); or 25% chance to hit an attack, 25% chance to parry with your weapon, and +1d6 damage with it on a hit (4).

Powerful Thought-Form.effect: Add 1d6 to your magic damage or your healing (1) or 2d6 (2).

Blood Magic.effect: You can use your HP (hit points) instead of MP (mana points) when casting a spell or ritual.

Multiple Shot.effect: Use a Heroic Point to perform 3 attacks with your ranged weapon.

Unlucky.effect: Every 4 rolls there is a 50% chance of automatic failure (-2), or every 2 rolls there is a 50% chance of failure (-4).

Overconfidence.effect: You can only move before performing an action.

Fury.effect: When reduced to 25% of your HP (rounded up), you enter a state of fury for 1d3 turns, and while in this state, you will attack anyone within reach, chasing the nearest enemy or ally to strike them.

Nearsightedness.effect: Reduce your visual range by 2 tiles.
